interface.longDescription: A symbolic interpretation copilot for astrologers using Astroanamnesis, the method developed by Eliseo Gallardo. Connect your Astroanamnesis account; the server checks its access permissions on protected operations. Explore only the chart view and context you expressly share from Maps through a private, revocable reference that expires after seven days. Resume one expressly shared notebook entry with its follow-ups; its previous response is included only if you select it. Request direct stations or the next exact Tropical natal transit from a shared chart with calculation access. Results come from the platform calculation engines and include their time context and a private result link. When you ask to keep a summary or a linked revision, the plugin prepares a draft for you to review, edit and confirm on the website; it does not automatically save or overwrite notebook entries. Choose Help me understand, Go deeper or Prepare a consultation, with response length and language preferences. The plugin cannot list all your people or notebook entries, recover other chats, calculate complete charts from new birth data in chat, process payments or change your account. It does not diagnose conditions, provide medical advice or replace professional judgement.

review.commerce_description: No payments or purchases are performed by this plugin. An Astroanamnesis account with active subscription access is required; the operator currently assigns access on the website. The tools cannot sell a subscription, charge a user or change a plan.

positive.description: A connected subscriber requests the available method references, without interpretation or reproduction of the documents.
positive.prompt: What Astroanamnesis references are available to my connected account? Give me the titles only.
positive.tools_triggered: subscription_status {}; method_index {}. No chart access or write operation is needed.
positive.expected_behavior: Check access and list only titles returned by method_index. Apply the returned response preferences if available. Do not invent documents, reveal email, reproduce private documents or claim to have accessed a chart.

positive.description: Use the dedicated reviewer account supplied in the secure access fields, never a real client record. The account contains the clearly synthetic saved person "Prueba técnica del complemento · 05-11-2026" (18 April 1992, 10:30, Madrid, Spain, Europe/Madrid) and synthetic notebook entries. Generate fresh references through the normal website sharing UI for this review: references expire after seven days. Use the SAME Astroanamnesis account when authorising the connection. Consent to the specific operation scopes when prompted. In Maps select the synthetic person and Astroanamnesis view. Open Interpret chart, review the prompt, share it and paste its freshly copied message as the immediately preceding user turn. This is the only chart reference supplied.
positive.prompt: Help me understand this shared chart in Spanish, with a balanced explanation. Identify the person, views and dates that were actually shared; do not add missing maps or biography.
positive.tools_triggered: subscription_status; shared_chart_read with exactly the shareId from the preceding user turn, offset 0 and successive nextOffset values until null; method_instructions with complete pagination; method_index; method_read with relevant returned IDs and complete pagination as required.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the authorised reference completely with consistent sha256 and identify its actual person, views and time context. Ground interpretation in the retrieved method; mark hypotheses and do not infer life history. Apply the explicit Spanish/balanced choice without changing stored preferences. A missing scope requests reconnection; an unavailable reference asks for the same account and complete reference rather than inventing expiry.

Include private result links; do not calculate positions with the language model or save anything.
